title: FLUX.2 Klein 4B: edit an image from an instruction
description: Edits a source image as the prompt instructs ("make the sky stormy", "change the bag to blue") with the distilled FLUX.2 Klein 4B: the source, scaled to the task's width and height, is encoded and attached to the instruction's conditioning with ReferenceLatent, and a new image of that size is sampled in 4 steps at CFG 1.0 (Flux2Scheduler, euler). The output has the task's size: the graph scales the source to it, and a soft check reports when the aspect ratios differ, since the source would be stretched; a task size with the source's aspect ratio avoids that. Width and height must be multiples of 16, which the latent rounds down to; the contract check refuses a task size off it. ComfyUI's template scales the source to one megapixel instead and takes the output size from it; here the task sets the size.

slots.label: Source image (file name in ComfyUI's input folder)

evidence.note: The skill's Klein pattern, written for Klein 9B: one CLIPLoader with type flux2 (not flux), flux2-vae.safetensors, the distilled model at 4 steps and CFG 1.0. Klein 4B takes the Qwen 3 4B encoder where 9B takes Qwen3-8B, as the templates below load it.

evidence.source: ComfyUI workflow template image_flux2_klein_image_edit_4b_distilled (comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.103, GET http://127.0.0.1:8188/templates/image_flux2_klein_image_edit_4b_distilled.json, sha256 7f1ead62d1456d485e95fb432fb492d2783f5ec9cfeefefe4ef71bfb448ba1a3)
evidence.note: The graph follows the template: CLIPLoader qwen_3_4b type flux2, VAELoader flux2-vae, the instruction's CLIPTextEncode and its ConditioningZeroOut each through ReferenceLatent with the encoded source, GetImageSize of the scaled source into EmptyFlux2LatentImage and Flux2Scheduler (4 steps), KSamplerSelect euler, RandomNoise, CFGGuider CFG 1, SamplerCustomAdvanced, VAEDecode, SaveImage. Changed: ImageScaleToTotalPixels (nearest-exact, 1 megapixel) is replaced by ImageScale (lanczos) to the task's width and height, so the task decides the output size; the template's second LoadImage, which nothing in its executable graph reads, is left out.

evidence.source: ComfyUI workflow template image_flux2_klein_text_to_image (comfyui-workflow-templates 0.11.103, GET http://127.0.0.1:8188/templates/image_flux2_klein_text_to_image.json, sha256 cd4a29b0be6f71a7391f2f023e69dfc3b47d7da9f2aa215b4c8b8e17c2eea107)
evidence.note: The template for Klein Base 4B samples 20 steps at CFG 5; the distilled model of this recipe samples as the edit template does, 4 steps at CFG 1.

evidence.source: GET http://127.0.0.1:8188/object_info, ComfyUI Desktop 0.44.0; the classes used captured in src/__tests__/architect/fixtures/object-info-desktop-0.44.0.json
evidence.note: UNETLoader, CLIPLoader (type flux2), VAELoader, ReferenceLatent (conditioning, latent), EmptyFlux2LatentImage (width and height 16 to 16384, step 16), Flux2Scheduler (steps, width, height), KSamplerSelect, RandomNoise, CFGGuider, SamplerCustomAdvanced (noise, guider, sampler, sigmas, latent_image) and VAEDecode are in the live schema. ImageScale (upscale_method lanczos, width and height 0 to 16384, crop disabled) and GetImageSize are too.

evidence.source: Hugging Face API: /api/models/<repo>/revision/main and /api/models/<repo>/tree/<commit>, read by scripts/architect/pin-source.mjs
evidence.note: flux-2-klein-4b.safetensors (bf16, 7751105712 bytes) and flux2-vae.safetensors pinned from Comfy-Org/Flux-2-Klein-4B at commit 5b3abca5, licence apache-2.0 per the repository card. The templates load flux-2-klein-4b-fp8.safetensors; this recipe binds the bf16 file, since fp8 support on Apple GPUs is unverified (ARCH 2026-11-16, precision). The Qwen 3 4B encoder is Comfy-Org/Z-Image-Turbo's qwen_3_4b.safetensors, the installed file, whose sha256 6c671498 is the pin's.
